## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npx prettier --check .`, and `npm test` pass
- [ ] Behavior changes have tests (for guard changes: one that must be rejected and one that must be allowed)
- [ ] No credentials, real hostnames, or customer data in the change
- [ ] README and `CHANGELOG.md` updated if user-visible behavior changed
